split_policy.first_run_policy: Freeze backend, prompt, parser, judge policy, thresholds and this file before any evaluation call. Retain failed calls and do not reroll or retune on this set.
split_policy.gold_visibility: Only individual source text and public problem enter inference. Gold steps, evidence, status and categories remain offline scoring data.

label_contract.complete: A unique full admissible path is explicitly asserted.
label_contract.partial: Only the explicitly asserted admissible applications are gold; missing steps must not be repaired.
label_contract.abstain: There is no unique asserted admissible path or the alleged applications are unsound/unadopted.
label_contract.expected_routes: Only an explicitly asserted first, branching iToken counts; forced completions are not recovered branch choices.
label_contract.evidence: Agent-authored verbatim annotations, not independent entailment proofs.
